name: tagging-doctor-worker
description: Tagging Doctor's checker: compiles a LaTeX project with LuaLaTeX and checks the PDF with veraPDF, one job at a time.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --input-type=module -e "await import('./src/server.ts'); await import('./src/runner.ts'); console.log('src loads under node type stripping')"
